title: chore: update community publisher access
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes NamanSoni78 from the community publisher allowlist.
- Existing listings were set to private separately in production; no model records were deleted.
- Prevents new public publishing after this change reaches production.

gist.headline: The garden gate update
gist.blurb: The community publishing roster got a small bit of tending. Existing listings remain safely private while the next set of public seeds stays deliberate.
gist.summary: Updated the GitHub-based community publisher allowlist by removing one publisher account; its existing production listings had already been made private and no model records were deleted.
gist.impact: Community publishing access now reflects the current roster, while the affected account's existing model records remain preserved as private listings.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful garden steward updating a small wooden gate's visitor list beside a private greenhouse of preserved code-plants. The scene represents maintained publishing permissions without implying deleted work: a tucked-away greenhouse holds the existing listings safely, while flowers and vines keep the setting warm.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny gardener hat, carefully updating a visitor list on a wooden garden gate beside a softly glowing private greenhouse full of preserved code-plants. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, with subtle pixel-font text: 'PUBLISHERS'.
